f.title: Establish a post-marketing surveillance system with a trained supervisor and ADR reporting from all countries before marketing authorisation
f.statement: During the approval process the registration holder must ensure that, at the time of marketing authorisation, an appropriate post-marketing surveillance system has been established, with a trained professional in charge of its supervision and adequate measures for reporting all adverse effects occurring locally and in other countries where the same product may be marketed, so as to obtain quality, safety and efficacy information.
f.applicability: Biological medicinal products registered by comparability with a reference biological product (biosimilars) in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.processes: Safety governance; Safety intake & collection; Local PV interfaces

rows.deadline: In place at the time of marketing authorisation
rows.quote: ARTICULO 9º — El Titular de registro deberá garantizar durante el proceso de aprobación, que al momento de la autorización de comercialización, se haya establecido un sistema apropiado de vigilancia postcomercialización, con un profesional capacitado a cargo de su supervisión y medidas adecuadas para la notificación de todos los efectos adversos que ocurran localmente y en otros países donde el mismo producto pudiera estar en comercialización, de forma tal de obtener información de calidad, seguridad y eficacia.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberá garantizar' = Mandatory; 'profesional capacitado' mapped to QPPV-equivalent (governance-1); 'efectos adversos' = adverse effects. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified; "El Titular de registro deberá garantizar" gives level and actor; time point (at marketing authorisation, during the approval process) explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 9 — The registration holder shall ensure during the approval process that, at the time of the marketing authorisation, an appropriate post-marketing surveillance system has been established, with a trained professional in charge of its supervision and adequate measures for the notification of all adverse effects occurring locally and in other countries where the same product may be marketed, so as to obtain information on quality, safety and efficacy.

f.title: MAH, technical director and manufacturers are jointly liable for compliance once the biosimilar is authorised
f.statement: Once registration and marketing authorisation are granted, the registration holder and its technical director, and the manufacturers involved in manufacturing and their respective technical directors, as applicable, are jointly and severally responsible for compliance with the provisions of the disposition.
f.applicability: Biological medicinal products registered by comparability with a reference biological product (biosimilars) in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Registration holder and its technical director; manufacturers and their technical directors
rows.quote: ARTICULO 10º — Establécese que una vez concedido el registro y obtenida la autorización de comercialización de la especialidad medicinal de origen biológico de conformidad con las normativas vigentes, el titular del registro y su director técnico, como los fabricantes que intervengan en el proceso de manufactura, según corresponda, y sus respectivos directores técnicos, serán solidariamente responsables del cumplimiento de las disposiciones establecidas en la presente disposición.
rows.review_note: Review: kept; Art 10 allocates joint and several responsibility for compliance (incl. the Art 9 PV duty) to MAH, technical director and manufacturers, which identifies the duty-bearers rather than only a sanction. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Below 90: "serán solidariamente responsables" allocates liability rather than using a duty-bearing modal verb; Mandatory is a judgement call.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 10 — It is established that once the registration has been granted and the marketing authorisation of the biological medicinal product obtained in accordance with the regulations in force, the registration holder and its technical director, as well as the manufacturers involved in the manufacturing process, as applicable, and their respective technical directors, shall be jointly and severally responsible for compliance with the provisions established in this disposition.

dates.title: ANMAT Disposición 7729/2011 (biosimilar registration): enters into force
dates.scope: Applicants and registration holders of biological medicinal products registered by comparability, Argentina
dates.quote: ARTICULO 16º — La presente disposición entrará en vigencia a partir del día siguiente al de su publicación en el Boletín Oficial.
dates.quote_en: ARTICLE 16 — This disposition shall enter into force from the day following its publication in the Official Gazette (Boletín Oficial).
dates.location: Artículo 16; publication data in the page header
dates.timing_note: Published in the Boletín Oficial 2011-11-21 + 1 day = 2011-11-22. The base date is the publication note of the Argentina.gob.ar normative database. Article 13 was later replaced by Disposición 101/2013 (B.O. 9/1/2013); that amendment's own date is not recorded.
